protocol.purpose: Author-designed controller fault injection and reserved scenario-family evaluation; not a blind external holdout or field-risk estimate
protocol.design_rule: Keep the input matrix, variant definitions, ordering, acceptance rules and budgets fixed. Do not tune production controllers or discard misses using these outcomes.
protocol.order: Rows in the declared order, separately within development and reserved partitions; no claim of search superiority
protocol.reduction_rule: First attributable detection per variant; greedily move demand toward the fixed priming case and shorten age/uncertainty, preserving primary failure category. Retain the service contract and priming state. Bounded simplification, not global minimality.
protocol.attribution: Reference must pass the existing electrical AND service contract. Detect candidate rejection, new electrical failure, failed service contract or a service loss exceeding the existing 0.1 kW tolerance. Reference failures are inconclusive, never counted as defect detections.

variants.nominal-control: Unmodified nominal selection with a different ID; negative control
variants.guarded-control: Unmodified guarded selection with a different ID; negative control
variants.skip-feasibility: Nominal ranker omits the nominal electrical-feasibility filter
variants.reverse-service: Nominal ranker reverses critical and total service ranking signs
variants.cached-action: Nominal controller retains its first action across a changed observation
variants.reverse-operations: Nominal selector reverses a multi-operation plan; interface rejection is separate from an electrical detection
variants.ignore-uncertainty: Guarded controller accidentally applies nominal filtering and loading rank; ablation against the explicit guarded specification

temporal.property: At position feedback and timeout, a restored claim must have received closed-position confirmation and actual restored kW must reach the planned amount within 0.1 kW. Variants receive only command, position and timeout messages, not physical state.
temporal.scope: One command per independent episode. Confirmation-before-timeout wins a timestamp tie. No multi-device coordination, feedback loss, stale-message IDs or protection dynamics. Do not compare unserved energy over unequal horizons.

protocol.evaluation_scope: Fixed, previously inspected cases on known synthetic models. Development and reserved labels describe case groups, not unseen holdout or field validation.
protocol.implementation_pin_reason: Shared replay comparator rejects non-finite values and Boolean/numeric type mismatches. Electrical models, cases, seeds, budgets, variants, tolerances and analysis settings unchanged; actual rerun under new source.
